summary: A white, editorial page with a fixed left index (Intro, Story, Design, More). Generative 'crystal growth' line drawings sprout over the hairline-ruled section heads and can be stopped with a 'Stop Growth' link. The story mixes a mock retro paint-app window with scans of 1880–1918 American and British gothic specimens. Design details are animated measurement diagrams; the end is a labelled editable specimen, a hover-zoom character grid, credits and minisite icons. Segmentation merged the last ~6000px (specimen → family list → character set → credits → minisites) into one truncated block.

instances.look: 'GT Zirkon' in hairline Ultra Light at ~288px, overgrown by dense clusters of grey tube-like strands and a small faceted crystal, like mineral fibres growing out of the letters
instances.feel: Organic and scientific at once, hypnotic
instances.ux: The strands grow continuously (generative SVG); a top-right text nav 'Stop Growth · Free Trial Fonts · PDF Specimen · Buy GT Zirkon' lets you freeze it; a fixed left sidenav (Intro, Story, Design, More) highlights the current section; loader shows an outline gem GIF and 'Loading…'
instances.learn: Pair a hairline weight with a generative drawing that grows over it, and offer a 'stop' link: the motion is the mood, the control is the courtesy

reconstruction.layout: Content column from x=165 (left 165px reserved for the fixed sidenav) to the right edge; hero band 1215×365 at y=85; name baseline near the bottom of the band, left-aligned, ~1000px wide; strands spill above and below into neighbouring sections; small nav right-aligned above (y≈20–80)
reconstruction.typography: Name ~288px GT-Zirkon Ultra Light, black; nav and sidenav ~12px GT-Zirkon caps/small type
reconstruction.behaviour: Inline SVG paths (≈190 KB) drawn by a generative script (credited to Prolog) keep extending as double-stroked tubes; onclick='stop()' halts growth; the same growth sits over every section head (section-head-* svg-wrappers)
reconstruction.assets: Generative SVG growth script; outline crystal and gem drawings; loader.gif
reconstruction.html: #sidenav > a.section-links-all#section-link-intro|story|design|look > h6; #container > nav.small-type > ul > a(onclick=stop()) + links; section#section-head-introduction > .svg-wrapper > svg

instances.look: A 7-line left-aligned paragraph at ~38px in black, a few growth strands crossing it
instances.learn: Puncture the gemstone metaphor in the intro ('may sparkle like a gem stone — but we think of it more like a heavy-duty tool') to set expectations

reconstruction.content: 'GT Zirkon freely mixes historical and contemporary ideas in this new sans serif design. Created by Tobias Rechsteiner over a nine year period…'

instances.look: 'Design process' head; two rows, each a short text column beside a mock 1980s paint-program window ('GT Zirkon Regular' title bar, × − + buttons, tool palette of pencils, brushes and shapes) showing 'Eggs' being typed and a glyph grid with a huge 'a'

instances.look: 'Design concept': six ruled rows, each a short text column beside an animated measured diagram: 'Heat' with a weight scale (U-Light…Black) and readouts 'Caps Stems [47|30] Lowercase [45|28] Aperture [125|160] Curves [50]'; 'MAX' Contrasted vs Linear with stroke values; 'Raw' ink traps; 'Quag?J2' with boxed terminal close-ups; 'Refitment' advance widths vs a traditional design (628 519 396…); 'Safe' italic on a protractor showing 13°
instances.ux: Each diagram is a looping video; no interaction
instances.learn: Animate the measurement itself (a slider sweeping weights while stem values tick, a protractor swinging to 13°): numbers in motion explain more than a static figure

reconstruction.layout: Rows separated by full-width hairlines; 1/3 text (≈360px) left, 2/3 diagram (≈760px) right, row heights 400–700px; ~2600px total
reconstruction.typography: Diagram words ~250–350px GT-Zirkon (Thin to Black, italic for Safe); readout labels ~12px in thin boxes; body ~17px Regular, italic for the italic row; small labels 'Contrasted Linear', 'GT Zirkon Linear'
reconstruction.behaviour: Videos heat.mp4 (weight slider + changing stem values), max.mp4 (contrasted ↔ linear strokes), raw.mp4 (ink traps), zoom.mp4 (terminal details zoomed into boxes), spacing.mp4 (narrow/wide widths vs traditional), safe.mp4 (13° italic angle with protractor and ruler); autoplay muted loop
reconstruction.content: Real metrics and claims: stem widths, 13° italic angle, ink traps in R, K, 8, g, uniform character widths
reconstruction.assets: Six MP4 diagram animations (animated by Josh Schaub)

instances.look: 'Typeface specimen': mineral-themed words in every style, each with a tiny label of style and size ('GT Zirkon Ultra Light — 21vw'): 'Bronzite' and 'Hardness' full-width at 21vw, pairs like '28 Surfaces / Pleochroism', 'Mariposites / Transparency' at 7.5vw, two paragraphs on X-ray diffraction at 38–48px, then 'Pattern 5' and 'Colorless' at 21vw in Black; followed by a two-column ruled 'Family overview' list (Ultra Light Italic … Black Italic)
instances.ux: Each sample (18) is contenteditable; no controls
instances.learn: Label every sample with its size in vw as well as its style: the specimen documents the responsive scale it is built on

reconstruction.layout: Full content width (1215px); 21vw samples one per row, 7.5vw samples in two columns (~600px each), labels directly under each sample; paragraph pair in two columns; family overview two columns with ~80px rows and hairlines
reconstruction.typography: Samples GT-Zirkon at 21vw (~302px) and 7.5vw (~108px), Ultra Light → Black with italics, features dlig, ss01, ss02, smcp ('XRD'), onum; labels ~10px Regular; paragraphs 38px/48px; family list ~60px
reconstruction.behaviour: Editable text only; some samples carry feature classes (type-dlig, type-ss01, type-ss02, type-feature-off)
reconstruction.content: Mineralogy words (Bronzite, Pleochroism, Mariposites, Quartzites, Arenaceum, Fluorescent) and a real-sounding XRD paragraph

instances.look: 'Character set': one continuous bordered grid of ~350 glyphs (accented caps, lowercase, figures, circled numerals, arrows with their ss01 alternates side by side), followed by 4-column credits (Typeface, Website, Visuals, Samples) and a row of six outline minisite icons (C, face, YO flag, &, star flag, G) linking to sibling GT sites
instances.ux: Hovering a cell shows it enlarged in a floating zoom box (#gt-character-zoomed), as on other GT sites; the credits and minisite icons close the page (seen in the HTML, mobile and video; beyond the truncated crop)
instances.learn: Place each alternate right next to its default in the grid (→ then ss01 →) so alternates are found without a separate section
